messages:
Maya: Quick check — vendor says they can do a soft QoS lease Sat-Sun but needs an exact 6h window. Who can coordinate the booking + quota bump?
Ravi: I can own the booking. How many GPUs and which region?
Jesse: We need 8x H100, eu-west1 preferred. If we do a preemptible blend we save ~30% but risk evictions.
Lina: FYI vendor told me EU sustained leases are limited Mon–Wed for dedicated slots; weekend is less guaranteed. We should confirm SLA before locking.
Maya: Okay — propose Sat 02:00–08:00 UTC (low traffic). @Ravi can you request a temporary quota increase and open a support case?
Ravi: Filing now. Ticket SUP-7219 opened against cloud support with details and expected GPUs + region. Also created infra lease LR-3345.
Ravi: gcloud command I used to request quota (for reference):
```bash
gcloud compute regions set-quota eu-west1 --add-accelerator='type=nvidia-h100,count=8' --project=redwood-prod
```
Ravi: Pinging vendor contact and attaching LR-3345 message: https://vendor.example/leases/LR-3345
InfraBot: Lease request LR-3345 created by @Ravi — state: pending_vendor_confirm. ETA vendor confirm ~48h.
Jesse: Add a fallback plan: if vendor can't confirm, route to us-west1 H100 reserved pool. @Lina can you check capacity there and whether we can free nodes by shifting canary jobs?
Lina: us-west1 reserved pool currently shows 6 available H100s. I can free 2 by shifting canary runs; I'll coordinate with canary owners.
Ravi: Support replied: temporary quota +8 GPUs approved for a 72h window, case SUP-7219-RESP. Attached response in the support ticket.
Maya: Great — final ask: Ravi, please post final lease window, exact VM shapes + images we'll spin so SRE and billing can prep. Leave the runbook here when ready. :thumbsup:
Ravi: Will do, drafting runbook now and will drop the playbook + escalation matrix here once finished.
